kicker.zh: 开发中 · 拆开计算机论文里的长难句
kicker.en: In development · Taking apart the long sentences of computer science papers

lede.zh: 计算机论文里的长句一读就晕，多半是因为找不到主干。把句子里的修饰成分一块块折起来，挂到它修饰的那个词上，主干就露出来了。从三个词的主干起步，一路拆到母语读者也要读两遍的句子。
lede.en: The long sentences of computer science papers are hard going mostly because their skeleton is hard to find. Fold each modifier into one piece and hang it on the word it modifies, and the skeleton shows. Start from a three-word skeleton and work up to sentences native readers have to read twice.

question.zh: 一句话再长，主干也只有几块：它们藏在哪？
question.en: However long a sentence, its skeleton is a few pieces: where are they hiding?

question.zh: 一个修饰成分说明的是名词，还是动作？
question.en: Does a modifier tell about a noun, or about the action?

question.zh: 名词后面跟着一整句话时，怎么把它折成一块？
question.en: When a whole clause follows a noun, how is it folded into one piece?

levels.showcase: marking: a stretch is chosen with two taps and then marked as a role

t.zh: 论文里的长句读不下去，多半是因为找不到它的<wiki-ref to="skeleton"></wiki-ref>：谁、做了什么、对什么。在这里，你把一句话拆开，直到主干露出来。
t.en: A long sentence in a paper is hard going mostly because its <wiki-ref to="skeleton"></wiki-ref> is hard to find: who, does what, to what. Here you take a sentence apart until the skeleton shows.

t.zh: 点一个词开始选一段，再点另一个词结束，中间的词就都选上了；只要一个词，就点它一下。选好以后，在下面把它标成主干的一个成分。
t.en: Tap a word to start a stretch and another to end it, and every word between is chosen; for one word, tap it once. Then mark it below as a part of the skeleton.

t.zh: 和标整个名词短语，比如 Our method；标整个动词词组。
t.en: The and the are marked as whole noun phrases, such as Our method; the as the whole verb group.

title.zh: Our method outperforms all existing baselines.
title.en: Our method outperforms all existing baselines.

body.zh: 主语 Our method，谓语 outperforms，宾语 all existing baselines：这就是整句的主干。句子再长，主干也只有这几块，其余的词都挂在它们身上。
body.en: Subject Our method, verb outperforms, object all existing baselines: that is the whole skeleton. However long a sentence gets, its skeleton is these few pieces; every other word hangs on them.

note.zh: 主干 = 谁 + 做什么 + 对什么。
note.en: Skeleton = who + does what + to what.

brief.zh: 标出这句话的主语、谓语和宾语。
brief.en: Mark the subject, the verb and the object of this sentence.

hint.zh: 先找动词：哪个词说的是“做了什么”？
hint.en: Find the verb first: which word says what is done?

tasks.sentence: Our method outperforms all existing baselines.

t.zh: 主语和谓语之间常常隔着一串词，它们都在说明前面的一个名词。这样的一串叫<wiki-ref to="modifier"></wiki-ref>，被它说明的那个词叫<wiki-ref to="head"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: Between the subject and the verb there is often a run of words, all telling about a noun before them. Such a run is a <wiki-ref to="modifier"></wiki-ref>, and the word it tells about is its <wiki-ref to="head"></wiki-ref>.

t.zh: 最常见的修饰成分是<wiki-ref to="pp"></wiki-ref>：一个介词带着后面的一串词。选中这一串，折成介词短语，再点它修饰的那个词，它就收成一块，挂在那个词上。
t.en: The commonest modifier is a <wiki-ref to="pp"></wiki-ref>: a preposition and the words after it. Choose the run, fold it as a prepositional phrase, then tap the word it modifies: it becomes one piece hung on that word.

t.zh: 修饰成分折干净以后，剩下的就是主干。不属于主干的词（比如说明程度的副词）留在原处，不用标。
t.en: Once the modifiers are folded away, what is left is the skeleton. Words outside it (an adverb of degree, say) stay where they are, unmarked.

title.zh: The running time of the algorithm grows quadratically.
title.en: The running time of the algorithm grows quadratically.

body.zh: of the algorithm 折起来以后，主干是 The running time grows：算法的运行时间按平方增长。of 短语只回答“谁的”。
body.en: With of the algorithm folded, the skeleton is The running time grows: the algorithm’s running time grows quadratically. The of phrase only answers “whose”.

note.zh: 先把修饰成分折到它的中心词上，主干就露出来了。
note.en: Fold each modifier onto its head, and the skeleton shows.

brief.zh: 标出主干。挡在中间的修饰成分，先折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton. Fold away the modifier that stands in the way first.

hint.zh: 动词是哪个？在它前面，是什么在变？
hint.en: Which word is the verb? Before it, what is it that changes?

hint.zh: “of …”这一串说明的是前面哪个名词？
hint.en: Which noun before it does the run “of …” tell about?

tasks.sentence: The running time of the algorithm grows quadratically.

the algorithm.zh: 主语若是 the algorithm，句子说的就是“算法在长大”。按平方增长的是运行时间；of the algorithm 只说明是谁的运行时间。
the algorithm.en: With the algorithm as the subject, the sentence says the algorithm grows. What grows quadratically is the running time; of the algorithm only says whose.

t.zh: 修饰成分也跟在宾语后面。这时它不挡路，但同样不属于主干。
t.en: A modifier can follow the object too. There it is in nobody’s way, but it is still no part of the skeleton.

title.zh: We describe an algorithm with linear running time.
title.en: We describe an algorithm with linear running time.

body.zh: 主干 We describe an algorithm；with linear running time 说明是什么样的算法：运行时间为线性的算法。
body.en: The skeleton is We describe an algorithm; with linear running time says what kind: an algorithm that runs in linear time.

note.zh: 宾语的修饰成分也折到宾语的中心词上。
note.en: An object’s modifiers fold onto the object’s head too.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifier away.

hint.zh: with linear running time 说的是什么东西的性质？
hint.en: What is with linear running time a property of?

tasks.sentence: We describe an algorithm with linear running time.

describe.zh: 挂在 describe 上，意思就成了“用线性的运行时间去描述”。with 在这里说的是算法本身的性质。
describe.en: Hung on describe, it would mean describing by means of linear running time. Here with gives a property of the algorithm itself.

t.zh: 一个修饰成分里面还可以有修饰成分：of the A of the B，后一个说明前一个里的名词。从最里面那一块折起，一层层往外。
t.en: A modifier can hold modifiers of its own: in of the A of the B, the second tells about the noun in the first. Fold from the innermost piece outwards.

title.zh: The weights of the last layer of the decoder in our model are initialized randomly.
title.en: The weights of the last layer of the decoder in our model are initialized randomly.

body.zh: 三层折完，主干是 The weights are initialized randomly：我们模型里解码器最后一层的权重是随机初始化的。一串介词短语里，每一个通常说明紧挨在它前面的名词。
body.en: Three layers folded, the skeleton is The weights are initialized randomly: the weights of the last layer of the decoder in our model start at random. In a chain of prepositional phrases, each usually tells about the noun just before it.

note.zh: 从里往外折：每一块挂在它前面最近、说得通的那个名词上。
note.en: Fold from the inside out: each piece on the nearest noun before it that makes sense.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分一层层折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifiers layer by layer.

hint.zh: 最后一个介词短语，说明的是紧挨在它前面的那个名词吗？
hint.en: Does the last prepositional phrase tell about the noun just before it?

hint.zh: 谓语 are initialized 是复数：被初始化的是什么？
hint.en: The verb are initialized is plural: what is initialized?

tasks.sentence: The weights of the last layer of the decoder in our model are initialized randomly.

folds.span: of the decoder in our model
of the last layer of the decoder in our model

the last layer.zh: layer 是单数，谓语却是 are。被初始化的是权重：of the last layer 说明是哪一层的权重。
the last layer.en: layer is singular, but the verb is are. What is initialized is the weights: of the last layer says which layer’s.

t.zh: 这句话的谓语是 is。它不是一个动作，后面也没有动作落到的东西；它只是把主语和后面那一块连起来，说主语是什么。这样的动词叫。
t.en: This sentence’s verb is is. It is no action, and nothing after it is acted on; it only links the subject to what follows, saying what the subject is. Such a verb is a .

t.zh: 系动词后面那一块叫<wiki-ref to="complement"></wiki-ref>。主干是主语、谓语、表语。
t.en: What follows a linking verb is its <wiki-ref to="complement"></wiki-ref>. The skeleton is then subject, verb, complement.

title.zh: The main contribution of this paper is a new loss function for imbalanced data.
title.en: The main contribution of this paper is a new loss function for imbalanced data.

body.zh: 主干 The main contribution is a new loss function：本文的主要贡献是一个用于不平衡数据的新损失函数。论文里交代贡献、定义、结论，常常就是这样一个“主语 is 表语”。
body.en: The skeleton is The main contribution is a new loss function. Papers state contributions, definitions and findings in just this shape: subject, is, complement.

note.zh: 系动词后面是表语，说明主语是什么。
note.en: After a linking verb comes a complement: what the subject is.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifiers away.

hint.zh: is 后面那一块，是在说主语是什么吗？
hint.en: Is what follows is saying what the subject is?

tasks.sentence: The main contribution of this paper is a new loss function for imbalanced data.

*.zh: is 后面跟的不是宾语：它不说动作落在什么上，而是说主语是什么。
*.en: What follows is is no object: it does not say what is acted on, but what the subject is.

title.en: The nearest is not the subject

t.zh: 动词前面紧挨着的那个名词，常常只是修饰成分里的一个词。谓语的单复数能帮你认出真正的主语：英语的谓语和主语在单复数上要对得上，这叫<wiki-ref to="agreement"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: The noun just before the verb is often only a word inside a modifier. The verb’s number helps pick out the real subject: in English the verb matches its subject in number, which is called <wiki-ref to="agreement"></wiki-ref>.

title.zh: The output of the attention layers is a weighted sum of the values.
title.en: The output of the attention layers is a weighted sum of the values.

body.zh: 主干 The output is a weighted sum：注意力层的输出是值的加权和。layers 离 is 最近，却在修饰成分里；is 的单数指向了真正的主语。
body.en: The skeleton is The output is a weighted sum. layers sits nearest to is but inside a modifier; the singular is points to the real subject.

note.zh: 拿不准主语时，看谓语的单复数。
note.en: Unsure of the subject? Look at the verb’s number.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifiers away.

hint.zh: is 是单数。它前面哪个名词是单数？
hint.en: is is singular. Which noun before it is?

tasks.sentence: The output of the attention layers is a weighted sum of the values.

the attention layers.zh: 主语若是 the attention layers（复数），谓语就该是 are。is 是单数，和它一致的是 output。
the attention layers.en: With the attention layers (plural) as the subject, the verb would be are. is is singular, and agrees with output.

t.zh: 这一次，主语和宾语后面都跟着一串套一串的修饰成分。
t.en: This time both the subject and the object trail chains of modifiers, one inside another.

title.zh: A small change in the weights of the first layer causes a large change in the output of the network.
title.en: A small change in the weights of the first layer causes a large change in the output of the network.

body.zh: 主干只有五个词：A small change causes a large change。第一层权重的一点小变化，会让网络输出发生很大的变化。长句的长，几乎都长在修饰成分上。
body.en: The skeleton is five words: A small change causes a large change. A small change in the first layer’s weights makes a large change in the network’s output. A long sentence is long almost entirely in its modifiers.

note.zh: 先折修饰成分，再读主干。
note.en: Fold the modifiers first, then read the skeleton.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把所有修饰成分折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding every modifier away.

hint.zh: 句子里有两个 change。各自后面的修饰成分，分别挂在哪一个上？
hint.en: The sentence has two changes. Which one does each chain hang on?

tasks.sentence: A small change in the weights of the first layer causes a large change in the output of the network.

folds.span: in the weights of the first layer
in the output of the network

t.zh: 到这里，折起来的介词短语都挂在名词上，说明“什么样的”“谁的”，这样的修饰成分叫<wiki-ref to="attributive"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: So far every folded phrase has hung on a noun, telling what kind or whose; such a modifier is an <wiki-ref to="attributive"></wiki-ref>.

t.zh: 介词短语也可以说明动作本身：在哪里做、用什么做、什么时候做。这时它挂在谓语的动词上，叫<wiki-ref to="adverbial"></wiki-ref>。同一个介词短语挂在哪，只能看意思。
t.en: A prepositional phrase can also tell about the action itself: where, with what, when it is done. Then it hangs on the verb, and is an <wiki-ref to="adverbial"></wiki-ref>. Where a phrase hangs is told only by the meaning.

title.zh: We train the model on a single GPU.
title.en: We train the model on a single GPU.

body.zh: on a single GPU 挂在 train 上：在一块 GPU 上训练模型。它紧跟着 the model，说明的却是动作。
body.en: on a single GPU hangs on train: the training happens on one GPU. It follows the model but tells about the action.

note.zh: 说明“什么样的”挂名词，说明“在哪、怎么做”挂动词。
note.en: What kind: on the noun. Where or how: on the verb.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来，挂到它修饰的词上。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton and fold the modifier onto the word it modifies.

hint.zh: 在一块 GPU 上的，是模型，还是训练这件事？
hint.en: What is on a single GPU: the model, or the training?

tasks.sentence: We train the model on a single GPU.

model.zh: 挂在 model 上，意思是“装在一块 GPU 上的那个模型”。这里说的是训练在一块 GPU 上进行。
model.en: Hung on model, it means the model that sits on one GPU. What happens on one GPU here is the training.

t.zh: 介词短语也会放在句首，用逗号和主干隔开。
t.en: A prepositional phrase can also open the sentence, set off from the skeleton by a comma.

title.zh: In this paper, we propose a new attention mechanism.
title.en: In this paper, we propose a new attention mechanism.

body.zh: 句首的 In this paper 挂在谓语 propose 上，管的是整件事。论文里大量句子都这样开头：In this section、In contrast、In practice。
body.en: The opening In this paper hangs on the verb propose, covering the whole event. Countless sentences in papers open like this: In this section, In contrast, In practice.

note.zh: 句首、带逗号的介词短语，通常挂在谓语上。
note.en: A phrase up front with a comma usually hangs on the verb.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来，挂到它修饰的词上。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton and fold the modifier onto the word it modifies.

hint.zh: “在这篇论文里”说明的是哪件事？
hint.en: What is it that happens “in this paper”?

tasks.sentence: In this paper, we propose a new attention mechanism.

mechanism.zh: 句首带逗号的介词短语说的是整件事在哪里发生：“在这篇论文里，我们提出……”。它和 mechanism 之间隔着整个主干。
mechanism.en: A phrase up front with a comma says where the whole thing happens: in this paper, we propose. The whole skeleton stands between it and mechanism.

t.zh: 这一句里有两个介词短语，一个说明名词，一个说明动作，而且一个套在另一个里面。
t.en: This sentence has two prepositional phrases, one telling about a noun and one about the action, one inside the other.

title.zh: We evaluate the method on three benchmarks for image classification.
title.en: We evaluate the method on three benchmarks for image classification.

body.zh: for image classification 挂在 benchmarks 上（图像分类的基准），整块 on three benchmarks … 挂在 evaluate 上（在这些基准上评估）。我们在三个图像分类基准上评估这个方法。
body.en: for image classification hangs on benchmarks (image-classification benchmarks), and the whole on three benchmarks … on evaluate (evaluating on them). We evaluate the method on three image-classification benchmarks.

note.zh: 里面那块挂名词，外面那块挂动词：一层层看意思。
note.en: The inner piece on a noun, the outer on the verb: read the meaning layer by layer.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来，挂到它修饰的词上。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton and fold each modifier onto the word it modifies.

hint.zh: “用于图像分类”说的是什么样的东西？
hint.en: “For image classification” tells what kind of thing?

hint.zh: 在三个基准上做的是什么？
hint.en: What is done on three benchmarks?

tasks.sentence: We evaluate the method on three benchmarks for image classification.

evaluate.zh: 挂在 evaluate 上，就成了“为了图像分类去评估”。这里 for 说明的是哪一类基准。
evaluate.en: Hung on evaluate, it means evaluating for the sake of image classification. Here for says which kind of benchmarks.

folds.span: on three benchmarks for image classification

method.zh: “在三个基准上的方法”说不通：在基准上进行的是评估。
method.en: “The method on three benchmarks” makes no sense: what happens on the benchmarks is the evaluation.

t.zh: 两句话长得几乎一样，with 短语却挂在不同的词上。
t.en: Two sentences that look almost the same, with the with phrase hanging on different words.

title.zh: We compare our model with the baseline.
title.en: We compare our model with the baseline.

body.zh: 同一个 with：models with different depths 是“深度不同的模型”，挂名词；compare our model with the baseline 是“拿我们的模型和基线比”，挂动词。动词自己要什么（compare … with …），常常决定了介词短语挂在哪。
body.en: The same with: models with different depths are models that differ in depth, on the noun; compare our model with the baseline sets the model against the baseline, on the verb. What a verb asks for (compare … with …) often decides where a phrase hangs.

note.zh: 形状一样，挂法不一样：看动词要什么，再看意思。
note.en: Same shape, different hanging: see what the verb asks for, then the meaning.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把 with 短语挂到它修饰的词上。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton and hang the with phrase on the word it modifies.

hint.zh: “深度不同”说的是谁？
hint.en: What is it that has different depths?

tasks.sentence: We compare models with different depths.

compare.zh: 挂在 compare 上，就成了“拿不同的深度去和模型比较”。这里比较的是几个深度不同的模型。
compare.en: Hung on compare, it means comparing models against different depths. What is compared here is models that differ in depth.

after.zh: with different depths 挂在 models 上：比较的是深度不同的几个模型。
after.en: with different depths hangs on models: the models compared differ in depth.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把 with 短语挂到它修饰的词上。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton and hang the with phrase on the word it modifies.

hint.zh: compare A with B 里，B 是什么？
hint.en: In compare A with B, what is B?

tasks.sentence: We compare our model with the baseline.

model.zh: 挂在 model 上，就成了“带着基线的那个模型”。compare A with B 是拿 A 和 B 比。
model.en: Hung on model, it means our model that has a baseline with it. compare A with B sets A against B.

t.zh: 一个介词短语前面有好几个名词时，它不一定挂在最近的那个上。
t.en: With several nouns before a prepositional phrase, it does not always hang on the nearest.

title.zh: We report the speedup of our implementation over the reference code.
title.en: We report the speedup of our implementation over the reference code.

body.zh: 两个介词短语都挂在 speedup 上：谁的加速（of our implementation），相对谁（over the reference code）。我们报告自己的实现相对参考代码的加速比。
body.en: Both phrases hang on speedup: whose (of our implementation) and over what (over the reference code). We report how much faster our implementation is than the reference code.

note.zh: 有的名词自己带着固定的介词（speedup over、improvement on）。
note.en: Some nouns come with their own preposition (speedup over, improvement on).

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来，挂到它修饰的词上。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton and fold each modifier onto the word it modifies.

hint.zh: over：比谁快？什么东西“比参考代码”？
hint.en: over: faster than what? What is it that is “over the reference code”?

tasks.sentence: We report the speedup of our implementation over the reference code.

implementation.zh: “比参考代码更……的实现”说不通。over 跟着 speedup：比参考代码快了多少。
implementation.en: “Our implementation over the reference code” makes no sense. over goes with speedup: how much faster than the reference code.

report.zh: “越过参考代码去报告”说不通。over 说的是加速比相对于谁。
report.en: “Reporting over the reference code” makes no sense. over says what the speedup is measured against.

t.zh: 句首、主语后面、谓语后面，都有介词短语。
t.en: Prepositional phrases up front, after the subject and after the verb.

title.zh: Since 2019, the size of language models has grown by a factor of a thousand.
title.en: Since 2019, the size of language models has grown by a factor of a thousand.

body.zh: 主干 the size has grown；Since 2019 和 by a factor of a thousand 都挂在 grown 上（什么时候起、长了多少），of language models 挂在 size 上。自 2019 年以来，语言模型的规模增长了一千倍。
body.en: The skeleton is the size has grown; Since 2019 and by a factor of a thousand hang on grown (since when, by how much), and of language models on size. Language models have grown a thousandfold since 2019.

note.zh: 一个动词可以挂好几个状语，一个名词也可以挂好几个定语。
note.en: A verb can take several adverbials, and a noun several attributives.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把所有修饰成分折起来，挂到它们修饰的词上。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton and fold every modifier onto the word it modifies.

hint.zh: 谓语是 has grown。从 2019 年起、增长了多少倍，说的都是什么？
hint.en: The verb is has grown. Since 2019, by how much: what do they tell about?

tasks.sentence: Since 2019, the size of language models has grown by a factor of a thousand.

folds.span: by a factor of a thousand

language models.zh: 主语若是 language models，谓语该是 have grown。has 是单数：增长的是规模。
language models.en: With language models as the subject, the verb would be have grown. has is singular: what has grown is the size.

t.zh: 这句话里有两个动词，可主干只有一个谓语。另一个动词有它自己的主语，它们合起来说明前面的一个名词。
t.en: This sentence has two verbs, but a skeleton has only one. The other verb comes with its own subject, and together they tell about a noun before them.

t.zh: 这样一个跟在名词后面、自带主语和谓语的小句，叫，通常由 that、which、who 这类开头。它和介词短语一样整块折起来，挂到它修饰的名词上。
t.en: Such a clause after a noun, with a subject and verb of its own, is a , usually opened by a such as that, which or who. Like a prepositional phrase, it is folded whole and hung on the noun it modifies.

title.zh: The method that we propose requires no labeled data.
title.en: The method that we propose requires no labeled data.

body.zh: that we propose 折起来，主干是 The method requires no labeled data：我们提出的方法不需要标注数据。
body.en: With that we propose folded, the skeleton is The method requires no labeled data: the method we propose needs no labeled data.

note.zh: 两个动词时，一个在定语从句里；折掉它，剩下的才是谓语。
note.en: With two verbs, one is in a relative clause; fold it, and the other is the verb.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifier away.

hint.zh: that 后面的 we propose 说的是哪个名词？
hint.en: Which noun is we propose, after that, about?

tasks.sentence: The method that we propose requires no labeled data.

propose.zh: propose 是从句里的动词：that we propose 只说明是哪种方法。主干的谓语在从句后面。
propose.en: propose is the clause’s verb: that we propose only says which method. The skeleton’s verb comes after the clause.

we.zh: we 是从句的主语。主干说的是方法。
we.en: we is the clause’s subject. The skeleton is about the method.

t.zh: 用逗号隔开的 which 从句叫：它补充说明一个已经确定的名词，不用来区分是哪一个。折法一样。
t.en: A which clause between commas is a : it adds something about a noun already pinned down, rather than saying which one. It folds the same way.

title.zh: Our model, which has seven billion parameters, runs on a single GPU.
title.en: Our model, which has seven billion parameters, runs on a single GPU.

body.zh: 主干 Our model runs；逗号里补充“它有七十亿参数”，on a single GPU 挂在 runs 上。我们的模型有七十亿参数，能在一块 GPU 上运行。
body.en: The skeleton is Our model runs; the commas add that it has seven billion parameters, and on a single GPU hangs on runs.

note.zh: 两个逗号夹着的从句，拿掉后主干完整。
note.en: Take out a clause between commas, and the skeleton stands whole.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifiers away.

hint.zh: 把两个逗号之间的那一块拿掉，句子还剩什么？
hint.en: Take out what lies between the commas: what is left?

tasks.sentence: Our model, which has seven billion parameters, runs on a single GPU.

parameters.zh: 这一块在逗号外面，修饰不到从句里的 parameters：在一块 GPU 上运行的是模型。
parameters.en: It lies outside the commas and cannot reach parameters inside the clause: what runs on one GPU is the model.

has.zh: has 在逗号里的从句中。主干的谓语在第二个逗号后面。
has.en: has is inside the clause between the commas. The skeleton’s verb comes after the second comma.

t.zh: 关系词有时被省掉：名词后面直接跟着另一个主语和动词。这叫<wiki-ref to="zero-relative"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: The relative word is sometimes left out: the noun is followed straight away by another subject and verb. This is a <wiki-ref to="zero-relative"></wiki-ref>.

title.zh: The features we extract are invariant to rotation.
title.en: The features we extract are invariant to rotation.

body.zh: The features (that) we extract：省掉了 that。主干 The features are invariant，to rotation 挂在 invariant 上。我们提取的特征对旋转不变。
body.en: The features (that) we extract: the that is left out. The skeleton is The features are invariant, with to rotation on invariant. The features we extract do not change under rotation.

note.zh: 名词后面直接跟着“主语 + 动词”，多半是省了关系词的定语从句。
note.en: A noun followed straight away by a subject and verb is mostly a relative clause without its relative word.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifiers away.

hint.zh: features 后面紧跟着 we extract：中间省掉了什么？
hint.en: features is followed straight away by we extract: what has been left out?

tasks.sentence: The features we extract are invariant to rotation.

we.zh: we 是被省掉 that 的从句的主语。谓语 are 说的是特征。
we.en: we is the subject of the clause whose that is left out. The verb are is about the features.

extract.zh: extract 是从句的动词：(that) we extract 说明是哪些特征。
extract.en: extract is the clause’s verb: (that) we extract says which features.

t.zh: 定语从句里也会有自己的修饰成分；主干的主语和宾语都可以带着一个从句。
t.en: A relative clause can have modifiers of its own, and both the subject and the object may carry a clause.

title.zh: The approach that we describe in Section 4 reduces the memory that the attention layer requires.
title.en: The approach that we describe in Section 4 reduces the memory that the attention layer requires.

body.zh: 主干 The approach reduces the memory。主语带着 that we describe in Section 4（里面 in Section 4 挂在 describe 上），宾语带着 that the attention layer requires。我们在第 4 节介绍的方法减少了注意力层所需的内存。
body.en: The skeleton is The approach reduces the memory. The subject carries that we describe in Section 4 (with in Section 4 on describe), the object that the attention layer requires.

note.zh: 从句里的修饰成分挂在从句里的词上，先折。
note.en: A modifier inside a clause hangs on a word inside it; fold it first.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分一层层折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifiers layer by layer.

hint.zh: in Section 4 说明的是从句里的哪个词？
hint.en: Which word inside the clause does in Section 4 tell about?

tasks.sentence: The approach that we describe in Section 4 reduces the memory that the attention layer requires.

t.zh: 一个定语从句前面有两个名词时，它修饰哪一个？从句里的动词是单数还是复数，常常给出答案。
t.en: With two nouns before a relative clause, which does it modify? Whether the clause’s verb is singular or plural often tells.

title.zh: We report the accuracy of the models that were trained on ImageNet.
title.en: We report the accuracy of the models that were trained on ImageNet.

body.zh: that were trained on ImageNet 挂在 models 上，所以它和 models 一起折进 of … 那一块。我们报告在 ImageNet 上训练的那些模型的准确率。
body.en: that were trained on ImageNet hangs on models, so it folds into the of … piece along with models. We report the accuracy of the models trained on ImageNet.

note.zh: 修饰成分跟着它修饰的词走：词折进哪一块，它也折进哪一块。
note.en: A modifier goes with its word: wherever the word is folded, so is it.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分一层层折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifiers layer by layer.

hint.zh: 从句里是 were：和它一致的是单数名词，还是复数名词？
hint.en: The clause has were: does it agree with a singular noun or a plural one?

tasks.sentence: We report the accuracy of the models that were trained on ImageNet.

accuracy.zh: 从句里是 were，复数；accuracy 是单数。和 were 一致的是 models：在 ImageNet 上训练的是模型。
accuracy.en: The clause has were, plural; accuracy is singular. were agrees with models: what was trained on ImageNet is the models.

folds.span: of the models that were trained on ImageNet

t.zh: 逗号后面的 which 有时不指哪个名词，而指前面说的整件事。这叫，折起来以后挂在主干的谓语上。
t.en: A which after a comma sometimes refers to no noun but to the whole event just told. This is a ; folded, it hangs on the skeleton’s verb.

title.zh: The training loss increases after ten epochs, which suggests overfitting.
title.en: The training loss increases after ten epochs, which suggests overfitting.

body.zh: which suggests overfitting 说的是前面整件事：训练损失在十个周期后上升，这说明出现了过拟合。论文里报告现象再下判断，常用这个句式。
body.en: which suggests overfitting is about the whole event before it: the training loss rising after ten epochs points to overfitting. Papers often report an observation and judge it in just this shape.

note.zh: 逗号后的 which 可以指前面整件事。
note.en: A which after a comma can stand for the whole event before it.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifiers away.

hint.zh: 暗示过拟合的，是“十个周期”，还是“损失在十个周期后上升”这件事？
hint.en: What suggests overfitting: ten epochs, or the loss rising after ten epochs?

tasks.sentence: The training loss increases after ten epochs, which suggests overfitting.

epochs.zh: which 若指 ten epochs，就成了“十个周期暗示过拟合”。暗示过拟合的是前面整件事：损失在上升。
epochs.en: If which meant ten epochs, ten epochs would suggest overfitting. What suggests it is the whole event before: the loss going up.

loss.zh: which 若只指 loss，就成了“损失本身暗示过拟合”。暗示过拟合的是损失在十个周期后上升这件事。
loss.en: If which meant only loss, the loss itself would suggest overfitting. What does is the loss rising after ten epochs.

t.zh: 关系词省掉了，介词又被留在了从句的末尾。
t.en: The relative word is left out, and a preposition is left behind at the clause’s end.

title.zh: The data the model was trained on came from three hospitals.
title.en: The data the model was trained on came from three hospitals.

body.zh: The data (that) the model was trained on：省掉了 that，on 留在末尾，等于 the data on which the model was trained。主干 The data came：模型的训练数据来自三家医院。
body.en: The data (that) the model was trained on: that is left out and on stays at the end, as in the data on which the model was trained. The skeleton is The data came: the training data came from three hospitals.

note.zh: 名词后面紧跟一整句、末尾还挂着介词：多半是省了关系词的定语从句。
note.en: A noun followed by a whole clause ending in a preposition: mostly a relative clause without its relative word.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifiers away.

hint.zh: data 后面直接跟着 the model was trained on：模型是在什么上训练的？
hint.en: data is followed straight away by the model was trained on: trained on what?

hint.zh: 这句话里有两个谓语样子的动词，主干的是哪一个？
hint.en: Two verbs look like the main one: which belongs to the skeleton?

tasks.sentence: The data the model was trained on came from three hospitals.

was trained.zh: was trained 在从句里：(that) the model was trained on 说明是哪些数据，即模型训练所用的数据。主干的谓语是后面的动词。
was trained.en: was trained is inside the clause: (that) the model was trained on says which data, the data the model was trained on. The skeleton’s verb comes later.

the model.zh: the model 是从句的主语。从三家医院来的不是模型，是数据。
the model.en: the model is the clause’s subject. What came from three hospitals is not the model but the data.

t.zh: 论文里描述数据集的一句：主语和宾语各带一个从句，从句里又有介词短语。
t.en: A line describing a dataset: the subject and the object each carry a clause, and the clauses carry prepositional phrases.

title.zh: The dataset that we release with this paper contains images that were collected from public sources in 2023.
title.en: The dataset that we release with this paper contains images that were collected from public sources in 2023.

body.zh: 主干只有 The dataset contains images。我们随本文发布的数据集，收录了 2023 年从公开来源收集的图像。
body.en: The skeleton is just The dataset contains images. The dataset we release with this paper holds images gathered from public sources in 2023.

note.zh: 每个从句都有自己的小主干；折起来，大句的主干就清楚了。
note.en: Every clause has a little skeleton of its own; fold them, and the sentence’s shows.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把所有修饰成分折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding every modifier away.

hint.zh: from public sources 和 in 2023 说明的都是从句里的哪个动作？
hint.en: Which action inside a clause do from public sources and in 2023 tell about?

tasks.sentence: The dataset that we release with this paper contains images that were collected from public sources in 2023.

folds.span: that we release with this paper

sources.zh: “2023 年里的公开来源”说不通：2023 年说的是收集的时间。
sources.en: “Public sources in 2023” is not the point: 2023 is when the images were collected.

folds.span: that were collected from public sources in 2023

body.zh: 点一个词开始选一段，再点另一个词结束；只要一个词或一块折好的成分，就点它一下。选好以后，把它标成主干的一个成分，或者折成一种结构：折的时候再点它修饰的那个词，它就收成一块，挂在那个词上。
body.en: Tap a word to start a stretch and another to end it; for one word or one folded piece, tap it once. Then mark it as a part of the skeleton, or fold it as a construction: tap the word it modifies, and it becomes one piece hung on that word.

body.zh: 点一块折好的成分再选「拆开」，它就展开回原来的词，里面折好的还留着。对照时，挂错的地方会告诉你那样挂是什么意思；没折的修饰成分只报个数。
body.en: Tap a folded piece and choose Unfold to open it back into its words; anything folded inside it stays folded. When you check, a piece hung on the wrong word tells you what that would mean; modifiers not yet folded are only counted.

body.zh: 一句话去掉所有修饰成分以后剩下的部分：<wiki-ref to="subject"></wiki-ref>、<wiki-ref to="verb"></wiki-ref>，再加上<wiki-ref to="object"></wiki-ref>或表语。读长句，先找主干。
body.en: What a sentence leaves once every modifier is taken away: the <wiki-ref to="subject"></wiki-ref>, the <wiki-ref to="verb"></wiki-ref>, and an <wiki-ref to="object"></wiki-ref> or a complement. To read a long sentence, find its skeleton first.

body.zh: 句子说的是谁、是什么，通常是谓语前面的名词短语。英语的主语几乎不能省。
body.en: Who or what the sentence is about, usually the noun phrase before the verb. English hardly ever leaves it out.

body.zh: 主语做什么、怎么样：整个动词词组，连同助动词（has been shown）。一个句子的主干只有一个谓语；别的动词都在从句或修饰成分里。
body.en: What the subject does or is: the whole verb group, auxiliaries included (has been shown). A sentence’s skeleton has one verb; every other verb is inside a clause or a modifier.

body.zh: 动作落到的东西，跟在谓语后面的名词短语。
body.en: What the action lands on: the noun phrase after the verb.

body.zh: 说明另一个词的一串词。英语的修饰成分大多跟在被修饰的词后面，所以名词后面常拖着长长一串。它说明的那个词是它的<wiki-ref to="head"></wiki-ref>。
body.en: A run of words telling about another word. In English most modifiers follow the word they modify, which is why nouns often trail long runs of words. The word it tells about is its <wiki-ref to="head"></wiki-ref>.

body.zh: 一个短语里被修饰的那个词：the running time of the algorithm 的中心词是 time。主语和谓语在单复数上要和中心词一致。
body.en: The word a phrase is built around: in the running time of the algorithm it is time. Agreement goes by the head.

body.zh: 一个介词带着后面的一串词：of the model、on a single GPU、for image classification。它可以修饰名词，也可以修饰动作。
body.en: A preposition and the words after it: of the model, on a single GPU, for image classification. It can tell about a noun or about the action.

body.zh: be、become、remain、seem 这类动词：不表示动作，只把主语和后面的表语连起来。
body.en: Verbs such as be, become, remain, seem: no action, only a link between the subject and the complement after it.

body.zh: 系动词后面、说明主语是什么或怎么样的成分：The contribution is a new loss function；The features are invariant。
body.en: What follows a linking verb, saying what the subject is or what it is like: The contribution is a new loss function; The features are invariant.

body.zh: 谓语和主语在人称、单复数上对得上：The output … is，The weights … are。读长句时反过来用：谓语是单数还是复数，能指出哪个名词才是主语。
body.en: The verb matches its subject in person and number: The output … is, The weights … are. In a long sentence, use it the other way round: the verb’s number points to the noun that is the subject.

body.zh: 修饰名词的成分，说明“什么样的”“谁的”“哪一个”：an algorithm with linear running time。
body.en: A modifier of a noun, telling what kind, whose or which: an algorithm with linear running time.

body.zh: 修饰动作或整件事的成分，说明在哪里、什么时候、怎么做、做到什么程度：We train the model on a single GPU。放在句首、用逗号隔开的，一般管整句。
body.en: A modifier of the action or the whole event, telling where, when, how or how much: We train the model on a single GPU. One up front, set off by a comma, usually covers the whole sentence.

body.zh: 跟在名词后面、自带主语和谓语的小句，修饰这个名词：the method that we propose。通常由开头。
body.en: A clause with its own subject and verb after a noun, modifying it: the method that we propose. Usually opened by a .

body.zh: 开头引出定语从句的词：that、which、who、whom、whose，以及 where、when。它在从句里还占一个位置（主语、宾语……）。
body.en: The word that opens a relative clause: that, which, who, whom, whose, and where, when. It also fills a place inside the clause (its subject, its object…).

body.zh: 用逗号隔开的定语从句（多用 which，不用 that），给一个已经确定的名词补充信息；拿掉它，主干的意思不变。
body.en: A relative clause set off by commas (with which, not that), adding to a noun already pinned down; take it out and the skeleton means the same.

body.zh: 关系词在从句里作宾语时可以省掉：the features (that) we extract、the data (that) the model was trained on。标志是名词后面直接跟着另一个主语和动词。
body.en: A relative word can be left out when it is the clause’s object: the features (that) we extract, the data (that) the model was trained on. The sign is a noun followed straight away by another subject and verb.

body.zh: 逗号后面、指前面整件事的 which：The loss increases, which suggests overfitting。它不修饰哪个名词，挂在主干的谓语上。
body.en: A which after a comma that stands for the whole event before it: The loss increases, which suggests overfitting. It modifies no noun and hangs on the skeleton’s verb.
